pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark contiguous regions characterized by high edge angularity and jagged pixel gradients. Morphology varies from multi-lobed star-like shapes on the mid-flank to more compressed, elongated polygons on the lower neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space with relatively uniform pixel thickness between patches. Junction nodes feature frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial convergences forming a complex topological web.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane extending along the cervical and thoracic dorsal ridge exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.
